description: This Java class defines the entity 'DepositAccountOnHoldTransaction' for managing hold and release transactions on savings deposit accounts. It includes fields for transaction details, methods for holding and releasing funds, and logic for reversing transactions.

classes.name: DepositAccountOnHoldTransaction
classes.description: Entity representing a hold or release transaction on a deposit account, including transaction details and methods to manipulate transaction state.

methods.name: hold
methods.description: Creates a new hold transaction for the specified savings account, amount, and date.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Creates a new release transaction for the specified savings account, amount, and date.

methods.name: reverseTransaction
methods.description: Reverses the current transaction, adjusting the savings account funds accordingly.

methods.name: getTransactionType
methods.description: Returns the type of the transaction (HOLD or RELEASE).

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Returns the amount involved in the transaction.

methods.name: getTransactionDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the transaction occurred.

methods.name: getCurrency
methods.description: Returns the currency of the associated savings account.

methods.name: getCreatedDate
methods.description: Returns the creation date/time of the transaction, with backward compatibility for older records.
